- **Green, still-living stems** that remain green while the rest of the plant has matured
- **Tan/brown dried pods** attached to the green stem — pods are mature and shriveled
- **Contrast between green stem and dried pods** is the hallmark symptom
- Similar field background (dark soil, dried plant material)

The test image shows exactly this pattern: green stems persisting late into the season with fully dried, tan, empty-looking pods — classic Green Stem Disorder.
